remarks: Located in a quiet, non congested neighborhood, this home is ideal for a family desiring quick access to the Village of New Canaan, and walking distances to schools and parks. Freshly painted and meticulously maintained, this spacious Ranch has 3 Bedrooms and 2 1/2 Baths. The Lower Level is completely finished and offers plenty of room for Recreation / Game Area, and a Play Area. City water, sewer, and gas. And Central Air Conditioning. South Elementary School, Saxe Middle School, New Canaan High School, and all of activities and amenities of Waveny Park and Mead Park are within walking distance. The Village of New Canaan and Train Station, are one mile away. Access to the Merritt Parkway and Talmadge Hill Station is 1.5 miles.
